free_text: The patient is a 65-year-old male with an elevated PSA of 8.6 ng/mL and a prior prostate adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 4+3 (ISUP grade group 3). MRI demonstrated a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the mid right peripheral zone with restricted diffusion, consistent with the clinical T2a staging. The management assessment indicates that individual treatment benefit and patient preferences require clinical review, balancing the risk of progression against potential treatment side effects.
